Attached: 2 images

A freelancer with a $1,320 invoice 21 days overdue pastes a generic prompt into ChatGPT and sends whatever comes back. The mistake is trusting a prompt before seeing what it produces. The fix: read the answer first. In this library all 240 prompts were run on 22 Nov 2026, each answer sits under its prompt, and your own details fill every prompt.

#ChatGPT #Productivity
